scope: input_new photographed unofficial English transcripts; both photos are the same source documents used for training and are not an independent holdout
cause: The line recognizer was trained and evaluated on PDF-aligned course crops, while production OCR was applied to whole pages containing long table rules and narrow credit/grade columns.
The OCR reading 151 Semester was not recognized as a new semester, moving the latest pooh courses into the previous term.
The 2.png page rectifies to only 595 by 696 pixels. Its tiny blurred glyphs corrupt course codes and academic years; bilingual fallback also misrouted it as Thai.
